cards.ex: The new laws significantly improve animal welfare standards on farms.
cards.exUz: Yangi qonunlar fermalardagi hayvonlar farovonligi standartlarini sezilarli darajada yaxshiladi.
cards.uzDef: Hayvonlarning sog'lig'i, xavfsizligi va baxtli hayoti uchun qilinadigan harakatlar.

cards.ex: We need to consider the value of ecosystem services when making land-use decisions.
cards.exUz: Yerlardan foydalanish to'g'risida qaror qabul qilganda, ekosistema xizmatlarining qiymatini hisobga olishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Tabiatning odamlarga beradigan foydali narsalari, masalan, toza suv yoki havo.

cards.ex: Overexploitation of natural resources is threatening the planet's future.
cards.exUz: Tabiiy resurslardan haddan tashqari foydalanish sayyoramiz kelajagiga tahdid solmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Tabiatda mavjud bo'lgan foydali narsalar, masalan, suv, o'rmonlar va minerallar.

cards.ex: Madagascar is a biodiversity hotspot facing severe deforestation.
cards.exUz: Madagaskar - jiddiy o'rmonlarning yo'q qilinishi xavfi ostida bo'lgan biologik xilma-xillik nuqtasi.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p xilma-xil hayvon va o'simliklar yashaydigan, lekin xavf ostida bo'lgan hudud.

cards.ex: Habitat fragmentation makes it difficult for animals to find mates.
cards.exUz: Habitatning bo'linishi hayvonlarning juft topishini qiyinlashtiradi.
cards.uzDef: Hayvonlar yashash joylarining kichik qismlarga bo'linib ketishi, masalan, yo'llar qurilishi tufayli.

cards.ex: We need more funding to turn the tide on rhino poaching.
cards.exUz: Karkidonlarni brakonerlik qilish bo'yicha vaziyatni o'zgartirish uchun ko'proq mablag 'kerak.
cards.uzDef: Yomon vaziyatni yaxshilashga harakat qilish, ahvolni o'nglash.

cards.ex: She's trying to rally support for a ban on single-use plastics.
cards.exUz: U bir martalik plastik idishlarni taqiqlash uchun qo'llab-quvvatlashni to'plashga harakat qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Biror maqsadga erishish uchun odamlarning yordamini yig'ish.

cards.ex: Change needs to happen at grass roots level if we want to see real progress.
cards.exUz: Agar biz haqiqiy taraqqiyotni ko'rishni istasak, o'zgarish oddiy aholi darajasida bo'lishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Oddiy odamlar orasida, jamiyatning pastki qismida.

cards.ex: Pollinators are crucial to maintaining a healthy food web.
cards.exUz: Changlatuvchilar sog'lom oziq-ovqat tarmog'ini saqlash uchun juda muhimdir.
cards.uzDef: Hayvonlarning bir-birini yeyishi, kim kimni yeyishi haqidagi murakkab aloqalar.

cards.ex: Invasive species can devastate local ecosystems.
cards.exUz: Invaziv turlar mahalliy ekotizimlarni yo'q qilib yuborishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Boshqa joydan kelib, mahalliy hayvon va o'simliklarga zarar yetkazadigan turlar.

cards.ex: Loss of habitat is the biggest threat to many species.
cards.exUz: Yashash joyining yo'qolishi ko'plab turlarga eng katta tahdiddir.
cards.uzDef: Hayvonlar yashaydigan joylarning yo'q bo'lib ketishi.

cards.ex: Sea otters are a keystone species in kelp forests.
cards.exUz: Dengiz suvlari dengiz o'rmonlarida asosiy tur hisoblanadi.
cards.uzDef: Ekotizimda katta ahamiyatga ega bo'lgan, boshqa turlarga ta'sir qiladigan tur.

cards.ex: The poaching crisis is pushing elephants towards extinction.
cards.exUz: Brakonerlik inqirozi fillarni yo'q bo'lib ketishga yaqinlashtirmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Brakonerlikning juda ko'payib ketishi va katta muammolarni keltirib chiqarishi.

cards.ex: The conservation status of the snow leopard is 'vulnerable'.
cards.exUz: Qor qoplonining muhofaza holati 'zaif'.
cards.uzDef: Hayvon yoki o'simlik turining yo'q bo'lib ketish xavfi darajasi.

cards.ex: The Amur leopard is on the endangered list.
cards.exUz: Amur qoplon yo'q bo'lib ketish xavfi ro'yxatida.
cards.uzDef: Yo'q bo'lib ketish xavfi yuqori bo'lgan hayvon va o'simlik turlari ro'yxati.

cards.ex: Human-wildlife conflict is a growing problem in many rural areas.
cards.exUz: Odamlar va yovvoyi hayvonlar mojarosi ko'plab qishloq joylarda o'sib borayotgan muammo.
cards.uzDef: Odamlar va yovvoyi hayvonlar o'rtasidagi nizolar, masalan, ovqat uchun kurashish.

cards.ex: They need to put stricter laws in place to protect marine life.
cards.exUz: Ular dengiz hayotini himoya qilish uchun qat'iyroq qonunlarni joriy etishlari kerak.
cards.uzDef: Yangi qonunlar, qoidalar yoki tizimlarni ishga tushirish.

cards.ex: The coral reefs are starting to die off due to rising sea temperatures.
cards.exUz: Marjon riflari dengiz haroratining ko'tarilishi tufayli nobud bo'lishni boshlamoqda.
cards.uzDef: Bir turdagi hayvonlarning birdaniga ko'plab nobud bo'lishi.

cards.ex: We need to ramp up efforts to reduce plastic pollution.
cards.exUz: Biz plastik ifloslanishini kamaytirish uchun harakatlarni kuchaytirishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga erishish uchun ko'proq harakat qilish, kuchni oshirish.

cards.ex: Pollution is taking its toll on the local fish population.
cards.exUz: Ifloslanish mahalliy baliqlar populyatsiyasiga zarar yetkazmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa yomon ta'sir ko'rsatishi, zarar keltirishi.

cards.ex: These animals should never be removed from their natural habitat.
cards.exUz: Bu hayvonlarni hech qachon o'zlarining tabiiy yashash joylaridan olib tashlash kerak emas.
cards.uzDef: Hayvon yoki o'simlik o'z tabiiy sharoitida yashaydigan joy.

cards.ex: Species extinction is happening at an alarming rate.
cards.exUz: Turlarning yo'q bo'lib ketishi xavotirli darajada sodir bo'lmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Hayvon yoki o'simlik turining butunlay yo'q bo'lib ketishi.

cards.ex: The zoo runs a breeding program for endangered gorillas.
cards.exUz: Hayvonot bog'i yo'q bo'lib ketish xavfi ostida turgan gorillalar uchun ko'paytirish dasturini olib boradi.
cards.uzDef: Hayvonlar sonini ko'paytirish uchun qilinadigan ishlar, ko'paytirish rejalari.

cards.ex: We need to practice environmental stewardship to protect our planet.
cards.exUz: Sayyoramizni himoya qilish uchun biz ekologik boshqaruvni amalda qo'llashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Tabiatni asrash va kelajak avlodlar uchun yaxshi holatda saqlash.

cards.ex: The wildlife corridor helps animals cross the highway safely.
cards.exUz: Yovvoyi hayvon yo'lagi hayvonlarga avtomagistralni xavfsiz kesib o'tishga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Hayvonlar bir hududdan ikkinchi hududga xavfsiz o'tishi uchun yaratilgan yo'lak.

cards.ex: We have to stem the tide of plastic entering the ocean.
cards.exUz: Biz okeanga kiradigan plastiklarni to'xtatishga harakat qilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Yomon narsaning davom etishiga yo'l qo'ymaslikka harakat qilish.

cards.ex: Wildlife conservation is at a crossroads; we need to act now.
cards.exUz: Yovvoyi tabiatni muhofaza qilish chorrahada turibdi; biz hozir harakat qilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muhim qaror qabul qilinishi kerak bo'lgan vaziyatda.

cards.ex: Activists are pushing for change in government environmental policy.
cards.exUz: Faollar hukumatning atrof-muhit siyosatida o'zgarishga undamoqda.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani o'zgartirishga harakat qilish, ta'sir o'tkazish.

cards.ex: It's time to take a stand against illegal logging.
cards.exUz: Noqonuniy daraxt kesishga qarshi pozitsiya egallash vaqti keldi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga qarshi chiqish, o'z fikrini bildirish.

cards.ex: Many species are under threat from deforestation.
cards.exUz: Ko'pgina turlar o'rmonlarning yo'q qilinishi tufayli xavf ostida.
cards.uzDef: Yo'q bo'lib ketish yoki zarar ko'rish xavfi ostida bo'lish.
